formalEvidence.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

numericalComparison.comparison: Exact integers, integer crossproducts and tick-derived seconds; no approximate or widened threshold.

independentReview.method: Four-season event calendar from actual commit inputs, with independently checked LIFO add/undo actions. Carry, min evaporation, inflow and overflow are derived from public forecasts. Every stored frame and interval is checked using absolute release age and independent per-category floor endpoints; no production tick controller or observed inventory reset is used.
limitations: Only the existing six public rounds are audited. No new gameplay, fixture, Model/pilot import or private plan is used.

Actual normalized inputs, reported armed states, navigation deltas, cancellation/season quarantine and receipt boundaries are linked. Full button rearming and navigation-repeat state machines are not independently replayed.
Invalid dt, runtime pause/retry and extra post-terminal calls are outside these ordinary observations. Per-case coverage lists encountered boundaries only.
Plans and reserved-undelivered water remain part of storage. Four-bank prefix restoration recovers recorded values and never fills missing physical ticks.

liveCaptureWindows.scope: Real continuous window, not a single-state image alias. Actual release age, category deliveries, storage and automatic season settlement/entry may advance during capture. Planning observations are also recorded as real windows, not assigned a fabricated exact tick. The image is not assigned to either endpoint alone.

candidateNormalPlay.scope: Only actual public observations. Sparse trace does not claim every 60 Hz interval; all four permanent receipt arrays are retained. Input-boundary water is separate from same-tick release and season entry. The unique six-case corpus retains every actual interval. Public menu planning does not advance the model, and screenshots never pause or force its state.
candidateNormalPlay.rootScope: Root personally opened all12 original-resolution candidate PNGs: three menus, large pause, two real planning edits/undo, spring/summer release, large/small victory, small menu/pause. Complete sidebars and frosted dialogs fit; labels and controls readable without obstruction. Active release screenshots remain genuine continuous windows; the canvas and slower DOM HUD may show neighboring delivery updates. No claim of a physical TV or phone test.
qaObservations: Personally opened all 12 original PNGs. The three menus show actual spring storage 100/90/80 and complete rules/controls.
The two-category planning image shows residents 5 and farms 5, storage 100 and free 90; the subsequent actual two-undo image shows all plans zero, storage/free 100 and no delivery.

Spring and summer release images visibly separate locked plans, actual received water, reservoir storage and seasonal forecasts. Spring canvas storage 89 versus HUD 90 is an adjacent refresh within the retained live window, not an exact synchronized state assertion.
Natural four-season settlement shows success with best score 1200; both viewport sizes retain readable complete menus, pause/win dialogs, sidebars, controls, tips and version.

gameRules.scope: Bind actual integer water accounts, four permanent receipt histories and saved observations. Closed-form seasonal release/priority correctness belongs to the existing independent audit; no Model, planner, new game or missing-interval reconstruction runs here.

modelTests.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryReservoirManagement.scope: Actual key edges, four immutable receipt histories and sampled integer water-account identities. A release observation is its snapshot last actual interval, deduplicated by model tick; a frozen result is never counted repeatedly as new delivery. Sparse gaps, missed boundary samples and unobserved last-action updates stay explicit. No missing interval, future allocation or hydraulic trajectory is reconstructed. Menu forecast planning does not advance the model or count as gameplay.

actualDispatchBarrier.scope: Actual post-dispatch state and next decision tick, or a later observed terminal tick; no unseen input interval reconstructed.

captureRecovery.originalFailure: Non-monotonic frame timestamps before encoding; completed gameplay and postcapture checks were retained.

errorArrayEvidence.scope: The pinned recorder passed its post-capture verifyErrors before the recorded timestamp assertion failed. That synchronous segment has no await; the pinned common verifier asserted all three arrays empty at that checkpoint. The raw arrays and any later shutdown-time events were not retained and remain unknown; null is not an invented empty transcript.

captureRecovery.scope: Encode the already completed real capture once from the same original JPEGs after stable timestamp sorting. Preserve the original failure and reception-order manifest. No resampling of gameplay, new input, retiming of timestamps, synthetic image, recapture or automatic retry.

encodedObservationAnchors.scope: Nine unmodified encoded images selected only from actual periodic public observations: three menus, actual planning with no delivered water this season, one recorded middle-of-release observation from each of four seasons, and a completed-year win observed after at least two seconds of natural terminal hold. Planning may show a zero or positive reservation; this is reported as observed and is never labelled actual delivery. No post-dispatch edge selection, predicted win time or extra Model run. Every image semantic still awaits personal review; receipt timing is not an exact pixel-state alias.

actualGameplay.artifactVerificationScope: Reuse completed fetch verification of signature, alignment, CRC, manifest identity and signed assets; compare those exact signed asset hashes with the actual candidate build. No second signature or full ZIP verification run.

sharedCliWindowHistory.cause: The first CLI omitted --seconds; unchanged shared driver used its 15-second default and called the terminal assertion before the four 8-second releases could finish. Saved actual state is playing/planning at tick932, summer, one completed ledger, no game failure.
sharedCliWindowHistory.scope: Source-window passed only proves unchanged bytes; it does not turn failed shared QA into a pass. All original attempt files retain exact post-source-finish bytes and original embedded paths, resolved by this mapping. No production, pilot, driver or game-rule edit; no formal, six-case corpus, candidate or art rerun.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
